trello.name: Fix staging deploy job by updating CI registry token
trello.desc: Owner: Ade. The staging deploy job has been red since this morning because it cannot pull the base image — the CI registry token expired after yesterday's token rotation. Ade will regenerate the registry token, update the CI secret, and re-run the deploy job. Deadline: within one hour. Acceptance criteria: staging deploy job goes green and the base image can be pulled successfully.

trello.name: Send updated Meridian proposal with new pricing to Lena
trello.desc: Owner: Ade. Kim promised Meridian the updated proposal with the new pricing by end of day today. The final numbers are in the spreadsheet; Ade needs to drop them into the proposal doc and send it to Meridian's procurement contact, Lena (email available from the kickoff thread). Deadline: end of day today. Acceptance criteria: updated proposal containing the finalized pricing from the spreadsheet is sent to Lena.
